brand.name: Monti Trentini
brand._contactNote: The sales contact block printed in the footer of buyer-facing documents (Quote Builder rate cards today). Canonical here rather than hardcoded in a component so it changes in one place and every future tenant carries its own.

pricing._note: The price list is HQ/Stefano's numbers — the engine does NOT invent pricing strategy. Class-of-trade only applies to DIRECT sales (Monti absorbs the distributor margin but holds market value to protect the channel). Distributor sales = base list price + delivery/minimum/fees. Real %s pending Stefano review (post first team review).

tiers.label: Wholesale / Distributor (price list)
tiers._note: Base FOB price as set by HQ — no class-of-trade markup; the distributor adds their own margin downstream.

tiers.label: Direct to Retail
tiers._note: Monti selling direct to a retailer — absorbs distributor margin, holds market value at +15%.

tiers.label: Direct to Consumer
tiers._note: DTC e-comm — +35% over the e-comm baseline, market value protected.

freight._note: Freight/handling are SEPARATE LINE ITEMS on the proforma — NEVER folded into $/lb, added at proforma time. Pickup (EXW SEAFRIGO) = no freight lines.

delivered._note: Trucking = $0.30/lb, floored at the local tri-state minimum of $300 (rep overrides for distance); it is an estimate until confirmed with the logistics provider. Processing fee = $135 on delivered orders under the 1,500 lb threshold.

fees.label: Trucking
fees._note: Auto-suggested from freight rules above; rep overrides with the real distance rate.
